notes.note: Traced the Session groups API from the credential-bound route through the pre-rename cancellation guard and exact Session and turn interruption. New launch closes on a lost run connection. A still-current original credential can request interruption of its accepted initial turn. Separate deferred and cascade owners retain their ordinary paths.
